name: hello-new
description: Upload links, shared pages and webhooks, in one call. People send your agent files, read what it made, and services call it back.

interface.longDescription:
hello.new lets ChatGPT work with people and services outside the chat.

- Upload links: when you need a file from someone, ChatGPT makes a page they can drop it on, with no account on their side. ChatGPT lists what arrives, reads small text files directly, and gives you a download link for the rest.
- Shared pages: ChatGPT publishes a report, summary or draft as a clean web page anyone with the link can read.
- Webhooks: a URL that Stripe, GitHub, a form or a cron job can call. ChatGPT reads every request that arrives.
- Link stats: how many people opened a link, and from which countries.

Links are anonymous and expire after 24 hours. To keep one, open its claim link and put it under a name of your own at hello.new.

Limits: files up to 50 MB and 10 per upload link, pages up to 256 KB, and 100 requests kept per webhook. Anyone with a link can open it, but only the link's key can read what arrives, and ChatGPT keeps the key to itself.
defaultPrompt: Make an upload link so Sam can send me the signed lease
Publish this summary as a page I can share with my team
Give me a webhook URL for Stripe and show me what it receives
